mechanism.claim: When the BTC perpetual experiences an extreme five-minute execution-count burst relative to simultaneous BTC spot, but spot's completed return does not confirm the perpetual return direction, the price move is sponsored by leveraged crowding rather than cash demand. During elevated BTC variation, fade the unconfirmed perpetual direction for eight hours.
mechanism.side: opposite the strict perpetual five-minute return sign
mechanism.why_distinct: Cash participation migration uses changes in spot quote-turnover share over two four-hour halves, with trade-count migration only as an unpromotable diagnostic. Small-ticket exhaustion uses single-venue six-hour count and average ticket levels. HVLEBR instead uses the causal tail of the simultaneous perpetual-to-spot execution-count ratio on one native five-minute auction and requires directional cash nonconfirmation. It uses no volume amount, ticket size, flow, basis, wick, funding, OI, fitted outcome, reused event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: causal trailing perpetual 24-hour realized variation must occupy its upper 35 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: irregular cross-market execution-count divergence onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.decision_grid: every exact UTC five-minute boundary D
features.market_bars: five exact coherent native one-minute BTCUSDT perpetual and spot rows [D-5m,D)
features.execution_count: sum nonnegative integer number_of_trades separately by venue
features.dominance_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.995
features.cash_nonconfirmation: spot_return multiplied by perpetual_return is at most zero
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact perpetual one-minute log(close/open) returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 8640 jointly valid decisions, minimum 6048, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: full directional burst true now and false at immediately prior exact source-valid five-minute decision; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after both completed bars and causal ranks are available
clock.reservation: global chronological half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not signal input; exact settlements only after novelty

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp/10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source and novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent leveraged execution-arrival crowding without cash price confirmation

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no market, bar, count aggregation, ratio, rank history, rank threshold, cash confirmation, variation, onset, side, clock, hold, subset, comparator, or control repair
